task_instance: Perform a weekly trail check-in on an Obsidian-vault trail: list trails with the bundled script, load one trail's details, then apply a representative set of check-in answers (progress, a new milestone marker, a metric change, task status changes, open-question updates, and a new review date) by updating the trail markdown file, and verify the update re-parses with the skill's own script.
evidence: Script present next to SKILL.md (trail-checkin/scripts/trail_checkin.py, stdlib-only). Created a sample vault inside the work directory under fakehome/Brains/brain/Trails/ with two realistic 'Trail - *.md' files, and ran the script with HOME pointed at that fake home so its ~/Brains/brain path resolved inside the work dir. 'python3 skill/scripts/trail_checkin.py list' returned both trails with status/velocity/last_updated/objective; 'show "Mental Health Tech"' returned parsed frontmatter, objective, current position, open questions, and the metrics table. Then, as the agent step after a check-in, edited the trail file: frontmatter last_updated 2026-01-19 -> 2026-10-31 and next_review -> 2026-11-07; posts metric 78 -> 82; added a Markers table row ([[20261031]] milestone); marked a task done and added a new task; resolved one open question and added another; appended a recent-published entry. Re-ran the script's 'show' to verify the updated file parses: last_updated=2026-10-31, next_review=2026-11-07, metrics posts=82, open questions updated. The deliverable (an updated trail file consistent with the skill's structured check-in) exists and is validated by the skill's own parser. The interactive AskUserQuestion selection/question step cannot receive real answers in this session (no user), so representative answers were supplied as sample input; this did not block producing or verifying the deliverable.
